cross_pipeline_notes.note: opal-data-portal-v2 is the shared write target for yang-pipeline, market-overview, news-pipeline, smartx-pipeline. S3 notification bindings owned by portal-notifications module (0.7.0_AE_CloudOps). Never add aws_s3_bucket_notification resources in pipeline-specific TF.
openpyxl-layer:1 is owned by bd-pipeline/layers.tf (0.6.0_AE_PartnerETL). Yang-pipeline references it with a hardcoded ARN. Coordinate with 0.6.0 before any layer version bump.
opal-313476888478-lambda-artifacts (artifact bucket) and opal-313476888478-lambda-layers (layer bucket) are owned by shared-infra (0.7.0_AE_CloudOps), state key shared-infra/tfstate.
opal-portal-lambda-role is a shared Lambda execution role used by market-overview and other pipeline Lambdas. It is NOT managed in any of 0.5.0_AE's modules.

lambda-execution-role is a broad shared role used by portfolio-management Lambdas. 0.5.0_AE added one inline policy (PM cache bust) to it in portfolio-management/main.tf — this is the only cross-module policy attachment in scope.
Causality market-updates DynamoDB table is managed by market-overview/dynamo.tf but written by causality-market-update-generator Lambda (causality pipeline). Cross-domain dependency.

opal-news-articles DynamoDB table is written by both news-pipeline (news-ingestion-scheduler) and seeking-alpha pipeline (analysis-scraper, news-scraper). Seeking-alpha is not yet deployed but will conflict if both pipelines are active simultaneously without dedup.
